component.name: IconFetch
component.summary: Give installed apps their real icons

description.p: IconFetch lists your installed apps with the icon each one shows now, and finds its real icon online: on Flathub, the Snap Store, the app's own folder or website, a collection of brand icons, or the Papirus theme.
Apps showing a stand-in, nothing at all, or a blurry icon are ticked for you. Apply, and the dock and app menu update right away, with no sign-out. Every change can be undone.
The arrows and found icons line up in one column on every row.
Much faster: the app list shows at once and fills in as icons are found, finds are remembered for a week so IconFetch opens in seconds, and the first search takes about a quarter of the time it did.

IconFetch's changes now follow your apps: when an app updates, its icon stays; when an app is uninstalled, its launcher goes with it instead of being left behind. This happens in the background within seconds of an install, update or removal.
Installs on most Linux distributions with one command, and as .deb, .rpm and Arch packages. Runs on GTK 4.6 and libadwaita 1.1 and newer.
